dialogue.en: A: Dad, I'd like to borrow some money.
dialogue.zh: A：爸，我想借点钱。

dialogue.en: B: Sure, Johnny, how much do you need? five bucks?
dialogue.zh: B：没问题，强尼，你需要多少？五块钱？

dialogue.en: A: Come on, Dad, I need thirty thousand.
dialogue.zh: A：别这样爸，我要三万。

dialogue.en: A: I wanna get into the market.
dialogue.zh: A：我想进入股市。

dialogue.en: A: You know, I'm tired of hearing all this news about the economic downturn, the inevitable recession, people stuffing their money in their mattresses.
dialogue.zh: A：你知道，我听够了所有关于经济衰退、不可避免的萧条、人们把钱塞到床垫里的新闻。

dialogue.en: A: I look at this as an opportunity.
dialogue.zh: A：我反而把这看作一个机会。

dialogue.en: A: This is a chance for me to get a jump start on building my nest egg.
dialogue.zh: A：这是让我抢先起步积累养老金的好机会。

dialogue.en: B: I don't know about that; with all the uncertainty in the markets right now, it would be a very unwise decision to invest.
dialogue.zh: B：这个我不太确定；现在市场有太多不确定性了，投资将是一个非常不明智的决定。

dialogue.en: B: I don't know if you're aware son, but there has been a lot of turmoil in the markets recently.
dialogue.zh: B：儿子，我不知道你是否了解，最近市场动荡很大。

dialogue.en: B: There have already been half a million layoffs in the last few months, and we have no idea how the proposed stimulus package will impact the economy.
dialogue.zh: B：过去几个月已经有五十万人被裁员了，而且我们还不知道提出的经济刺激方案会对经济产生什么影响。

dialogue.en: B: There's just too much instability.
dialogue.zh: B：有太多不稳定性了。

dialogue.en: B: I wouldn't feel comfortable investing in this climate.
dialogue.zh: B：在这种环境下投资，我无法安心。

dialogue.en: A: But look at it this way, every challenge is an opportunity.
dialogue.zh: A：但换个角度看，每个挑战都是机遇。

dialogue.en: A: And anyway, I'm not talking about investing 8 in the domestic market.
dialogue.zh: A：再说了，我不是在说投资国内市场。

dialogue.en: A: There are emerging markets that promise great returns.
dialogue.zh: A：有一些新兴市场承诺了很高的回报。

dialogue.en: A: Look at China, for example; they have 1.4 billion people, half a billion of whom have recently entered the middle class.
dialogue.zh: A：比如中国，他们有14亿人口，其中五亿最近进入了中产阶级。

dialogue.en: A: Here alone, the aggregate demand for consumer goods re Presents an amazing wealth generating opportunity.
dialogue.zh: A：光是这一点，消费品的总需求就代表了一个令人难以置信的财富创造机会。

dialogue.en: B: Come on, son, you're looking at this too naively, the Chinese market has exhibited a great deal of instability, and their currency has been devalued by almost a whole percentage point.
dialogue.zh: B：得了吧儿子，你看得太天真了，中国市场表现出了很大的不稳定性，他们的货币已经贬值了将近一个百分点。

dialogue.en: A: Fine, then!
dialogue.zh: A：好吧，算了！

dialogue.en: A: If that's the way you feel, so be it.
dialogue.zh: A：如果你是这样想的，那就这样吧。

dialogue.en: A: But you're losing out on a great opportunity here.
dialogue.zh: A：但你正在错失一个巨大的机会。

dialogue.en: A: I'm going to go hit up Mum for the cash.
dialogue.zh: A：我去找妈妈要钱。
